post.title: The best AI walker kept climbing. The crowd fell.
post.caption: The best AI walker kept climbing. The crowd fell. Gen 1: the best walked 418 and the average went backwards. The average hit 2033 at gen 29, then dropped to 1488 by gen 34, while the best kept going to 3280 at gen 40. No instructions, just evolution: each generation the best walkers are copied with random tweaks.
post.pinned: Every generation the best walkers survive and get copied with small random mutations. Nobody tells them how to walk.
